<b>Silver Bells</b> are [[Items (Silksong)#Deliverables|deliverable items]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>.

== Use ==
Eight Silver Bells are required to complete the <i>[[Silver Bells]]</i> [[wish]], available from [[Bellhart]]'s [[wishwall]] after completing the <i>[[SAVE: The Threadspun Town]]</i> objective.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Frey 01.png!Location of the wishwall in Bellhart
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Frey 01.png!Wishwall in Bellhart
}}

== How to Acquire ==
Silver Bells can be found in the bellvein tunnels above and below [[Bellhart]] during the <i>[[Silver Bells]]</i> [[wish]]. They drop randomly in specific locations and need to be picked up.

There are seven bell-spawning locations above the town and seven below it. When Hornet enters the room, each location determines which bell it contains, with a 75% chance for a regular bell and a 25% chance for a Silver Bell. The location then waits for Hornet to approach within 14 units before triggering the drop. If she does not enter this range before a 15-second timer expires, the bell drops automatically.

Once dropped, a bell is guaranteed to remain for at least 8 seconds. After this time, if Hornet is more than 15 units away, the bell despawns and the location prepares a new drop. Once a Silver Bell is collected, its location prepares a new bell after 5-8 seconds. Each location cannot drop more than four regular bells in a row, and Silver Bells are limited to a maximum of two consecutive drops. Equipping the [[Magnetite Dice]] increases the limit for Silver Bells to three and raises their overall spawn chance to 30%.

In practice, this means that the best way to complete the wish is to move around the area in loops. Underneath Bellhart, taking a circular route around the bellveins without exiting the room provides enough distance for dropped bells to despawn and reset. Alternatively, exiting the room despawns all currently dropped bells.

Once eight Silver Bells have been collected, they cease to spawn.
